detail: Association between ABCB1 C3435T polymorphism and increased risk of cannabis dependence. (2009). [http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/19625010] Patients with cannabis dependence (n=40) had a significantly higher 3435C allele frequency (62.5% versus 43.8% respectively, P=0.017) and CC genotype (50% versus 20%, P=0.005, OR=4.00 [1.50-10.60]). summary: altered drug metabolism and bioavailability; moderately increased risk for certain cancers
detail: This is the homozygous variant of C3435T, on the gene encoding P-glycoprotein (called MDR1 or ABCB1). P-glycoprotein is a protein involved in pumping foreign substances out of cells.
